hints.tr: Anahtar dışında dizinde durması istenen sütunlar `INCLUDE (...)` ile ekleniyor: `CREATE INDEX ad ON tablo (anahtar) INCLUDE (sütun);`.
hints.en: Columns that should sit in the index outside the key are added with `INCLUDE (...)`: `CREATE INDEX name ON table (key) INCLUDE (column);`.

hints.tr: `(created_at, amount)` da sorguyu kapsıyor ama `amount`'u sıralamaya katıyor; burada istenen `INCLUDE`. Dizin yapısıyla denetleniyor: anahtar yalnızca `created_at`, eklenen `amount`.
hints.en: `(created_at, amount)` also covers the query, but it puts `amount` into the sort order; what is asked for here is `INCLUDE`. The index is checked by its structure: the key is `created_at` only, the included column `amount`.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE INDEX ix_events_created ON events (created_at) INCLUDE (amount);
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE INDEX ix_events_created ON events (created_at) INCLUDE (amount);
```

checks.query: SELECT STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN ic.is_included_column = 0 THEN c.name END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal, c.name) AS key_columns, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN ic.is_included_column = 1 THEN c.name END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal, c.name) AS included_columns, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID('events') AND i.is_primary_key = 0 GROUP BY i.index_id, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition ORDER BY key_columns;
